snippet.title: White Line North Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Build your kennel. Find your perfect eight. Race across snow, ice and mountain trails in a dog sled racing and management game. Breed and care for your dogs, upgrade your gear, and work your way from the Village Derby to the Great Northern Tour.
